title: Grateful Dead Live at Robert F. Kennedy Stadium on 1990-07-12
source: Master Audience Recorded By Steve Hill, Transfer By Keo; 2 Nakamichi CM100/CP4 Shotguns + 1 Sennheiser 421 > Unknown Mixer (Either A Radio Shack Or Boss) 1/4 Inch In/RCA Out > Sony TC-D5m, Tapes:Maxell MX 90 + 100; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1 > Korg MR-1000 @ 1 Bit/5.6 MHz; Tracking/Sample Rate Conversion With AudioGate Software To 32/96 kHz Wave; Dithered/Flacked With Korg Aqua To 16/44; SBE's Checked/Fixed With Trader's Little Helper; Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename

ai_review.summary: Excellent recording captures a rain‑soaked DC show bursting with high energy from both band and audience
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the performance as energized by the sudden downpour, noting the crowd’s excitement and even hearing the band comment on the weather between songs. They also commend the tape quality, calling it a great recording that sounds far clearer than older outdoor captures.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review highlights an energetic show and high‑quality recording, suggesting a strong overall experience but limited data for confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear capture of rain ambience and band banter; reviewer notes it sounds much better than previous outdoor tapes.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Weather played a major role, driving dynamic shifts and high vibes throughout the set; crowd energy is palpable between songs.
